capeCid.description: Optional CID of the cape blob in the player's repo.

capeUrl.description: Optional public URL of the player's cape PNG.

skinCid.description: Optional CID of the skin blob in the player's repo.

skinUrl.description: Public URL of the player's skin PNG.

endorsements.description: Server signatures over the canonical skin payload.

main.description: One skin record per player per server. The skin URL is required; an optional blob CID may be preferred by consumers. The record must carry at least one server endorsement. The record key is the server's signing key id.

description: Server-endorsed player skin and cape references for ATPcraft. Each record is signed by the ATPcraft server that wrote it so other servers can verify the skin.
